findings.title: Concurrency test asserts without joining the reader thread
findings.body: The test starts a non-daemon reader thread that loops over group reads until deletedAll is set, then immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty after setting deletedAll and deleting groups. There is no thread.join(), so the assertion races with the reader's final HTTP call: an NPE or other exception raised after the assertion is never observed, making the test unable to reliably catch the regression it targets. Also, if deletion throws before deletedAll.set(true), the reader never gets the stop signal and can keep running against the test realm during teardown, leaking a non-daemon thread. Join the reader thread (with a timeout) or otherwise synchronize termination before asserting, and ensure the stop flag is set in a finally block.
